title: Generate a privacy notice
prompt: Write a privacy policy for my Lovable-built booking app for a hair salon in Pretoria. We use Supabase (EU region), Resend for email and Google Analytics.
must: Covers the s18(1) items: information collected, responsible party name and address, purpose, voluntary or mandatory, consequences of not providing, any law requiring collection
Discloses cross-border transfers (EU, US) and the protection level (s18(1)(g))
Names the Information Officer and the right to complain to the Information Regulator with contact details
Explains rights: access, correction, deletion, objection
States it is a draft for review, not legal advice
must_not: Uses GDPR terms like controller or DPO without SA equivalents
Invents a registration number or Information Officer name presented as real
